provenance.procedure: scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tvdb login  (requires a real TVDB v4 API key in TVDB_API_KEY); synthesised here from the published v4 /login contract because CI has no key and none may be committed (ADR-0026).
provenance.note: Synthesised: TheTVDB v4 login exchanges {"apikey": ...} for a bearer token. The token here is a placeholder; the real value is a JWT. Body is not matched by the replay harness, only method+path, so any apikey drives this response.
